sloka: सकामा भवकैकेयि विधवा राज्य मावस ।न हि तम् पुरुष व्याघ्रम् विना जीवितुम् उत्सहे ॥२-४२-२१॥
transliteration: sakāmā bhavakaikeyi vidhavā rājya māvasa ।na hi tam puruṣa vyāghram vinā jīvitum utsahe ॥2-42-21॥

translations.english: O Kaikeyi, your desire is fulfilled. Rule the kingdom as a widow. Without Rama, the best of men, I don't desire to live.
